changelog:
- Initial release of Football English: a bilingual football quiz for learning English vocabulary.
- Fully interactive experience using only Telegram inline buttons for all actions—no text input required.
- Includes quiz modes, vocabulary learning, and review features.
- Each question provides a new football-related English word with a Russian translation.
- Enthusiastic and educational tone with football emojis throughout the experience.
summary: Football quiz in English! Test your knowledge about football while learning English vocabulary. Используй когда пользователь просит football quiz, футбольную...
